featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Kunal,
With all due respect, Your review seems to be result of ill-informed and immature mind.
Not allowing relatives of patient and not giving CD of test is according to Indian government notification under the PCPNDT (Pre-conception and prenatal Diagnostic tests Act). At ‘Omkar Sonography and Diagnostics’, we abide by all rules and regulations of government of India. Two A4 size pages of colour images were given to you along with complete report.
The charges (Doctor fees) of different sonography are different and varies at different centres. Your relatives scan was TIFFA scan (Targeted Imaging For Fetal Anomalies). Many centres in Mumbai charge more than ₹5000 for this scan. The fees was conveyed to you before undergoing the test and only partial fees was taken before test which is the norm in everywhere. You had the option of not doing the test at our clinic. The decision of undergoing the test was yours. And yes the charges are per test basis and are to be paid each time. It's like the same way you pay every time you go for movies or eat in a restaurant.
I hope it's not too difficult to understand.
